title: Values Decision Table: Long-Coverage Reduction of the Rate on Interest Extinguished at a Whole Life Insurance Loan Offset
content:
**Scope:** loan offsets on Ashgrove Whole Life Insurance policies, including policies issued by conversion of an Ashgrove Term Life Insurance policy.

**Rule.** The series rate at which interest is extinguished at a loan offset is reduced for long continuous coverage on the insured, counted in whole months **to the date the offset is booked**, from the issue date of the Ashgrove Term Life Insurance policy converted into this policy, or from this policy's own issue date when it was not issued by conversion. The reduction is **1.5 percentage points (0.015)** where the count is at least **360** months and the policy has never been reinstated, **0.75 percentage point (0.0075)** where the count is at least **240** months but below 360 and the policy has never been reinstated, and nothing otherwise. The rate charged is the series rate less the reduction.

## Decision table

| Converted from Term Life Insurance | Start of the count | Whole months to the booking date | Never reinstated | Reduction |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | Issue date on the Term Life Insurance policy record | 360 or more | Yes | 0.015 |
| Yes | Issue date on the Term Life Insurance policy record | 240 to 359 | Yes | 0.0075 |
| No | Whole life issue date | 360 or more | Yes | 0.015 |
| No | Whole life issue date | 240 to 359 | Yes | 0.0075 |
| Either | Either | Below 240 | Yes | None |
| Either | Either | Any | No (a reinstatement date is shown) | None |

A whole month is counted each time the same day of the month as the start date is reached.

## Cases (hypothetical)

- Term Life Insurance policy issued November 20, 1995, converted in 2007; offset booked November 19, 2025: 359 months, reduction 0.0075; booked November 20, 2025: 360 months, reduction 0.015.
- Whole life policy issued on its own application on May 2, 2010: 15 years of coverage, below 240 months, no reduction.
- A converted policy with 400 months of coverage that was reinstated in 2019: no reduction.
